hero.title: See what AI knows about you.
hero.subtitle: Enter your name and your email. We look up what's public about you — breaches, profiles, and what AI assistants say — and explain it plainly, in a report scored from 0 to 100.

trust.verify: We verify your email before we search

form.title: Get your report
form.emailHelp: We send a link to confirm it's yours. Without that step we generate nothing.
form.cityHelp: Helps tell you apart from people with the same name.
form.consent: I have read the {privacy} and I consent to Rastro searching public information about me and sending me the report.
form.onlyYourself: You can only request a report about yourself.

formErrors.consent: We need your consent to continue.
formErrors.rateLimit: You've requested too many reports today. Try again tomorrow.
formErrors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it and we'll start preparing your report.
sent.spam: If it doesn't arrive within a few minutes, check spam or promotions.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Title: You give us your name and email
how.step1Body: That's all. No passwords, no documents, no access to your accounts.
how.step2Title: You confirm the email is yours
how.step2Body: You get a link. Until you open it, we search nothing.
how.step3Body: A score from 0 to 100, what's visible about you, why it matters, and what you can do.

verify.okBody: We can now prepare your report.
verify.invalidBody: It may have been used already, or copied incorrectly. Request a new one.
verify.expiredBody: Links last 24 hours. Request a new one and it'll be in your inbox.
verify.soonBody: Report generation is coming in the next few days. We'll let you know at this same address.

email.subject: Confirm your email to see your Rastro report
email.preheader: One click and we start preparing your report.
email.body: You requested an exposure report from Rastro. Confirm this email is yours and we'll get started.
email.fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this address into your browser:
email.ignore: If this wasn't you, ignore this message. We won't do anything.
email.footer: Rastro — See what AI knows about you.

footer.tagline: See what AI knows about you.

legalStub.body: This text has not been written yet. It ships on Day 6, before the service opens to anyone. In short: the legal basis is your consent, we only process your name, your email and optionally your city, data is deleted after 30 days, and you can exercise your rights by writing to the contact that will appear here.
